<u>**Statistical and Modeling Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Explain CoGAPS as linked non-negative matrices: gene loadings that define patterns and cell scores that measure pattern use.
1. Evaluate candidate values of `K` using precomputed rank-selection evidence, including stability, redundancy, temporal signal, biological resolution, and sensitivity comparison.
1. Read model diagnostics before treating selected-model outputs as interpretable evidence.
1. Distinguish non-negative pattern scores or gene loadings from gene-expression direction, then use pseudobulk directionality to ask whether top pattern genes increase or decrease relative to baseline.
